Nearest-wrong counterfactual: laundering it into projectileExplosionPct (the Explosion DAMAGE bucket — a different mechanic) or any Damage-Up stat would fabricate per-shot damage the kit never grants. Nearest-wrong counterfactuals: dropping the gate (a permanent ~14.96% per-shot rider + phantom burst gauge) or re-reading it as a hit-COUNT trigger; the spec test pins zero skill-bucket damage from her slot against both. ⚑ LIST (out-of-domain, damage contribution in sim domain is exactly 0 for both): (1) Explosion Radius — ESTIMATE: 0 in domain; on multi-enemy wave content it would raise splash COVERAGE, not per-enemy damage; RECIPE: needs a multi-enemy/spatial-AoE encounter model before any radius stat can be load-bearing; TIER: out-of-domain (no single-boss observable). (2) S2 multi-enemy gate + DEF-shred + rider — ESTIMATE: 0 in domain; on 5+-enemy waves it would be a small team lift (3.52% DEF-down is a minor multiplicative vs boss DEF, rider is 14.96% of a 61.3 normal mult on qualifying splashes only); RECIPE: needs a multi-enemy encounter model + a target-DEF-down debuff primitive; TIER: out-of-domain.
